commentary: Current spot rates show a clear waterfall: B200 at $5-8/hr, H200 at $3.20-5.06/hr, H100 at $1.73-3.51/hr, A100 at $0.27-1.75/hr, and L40S (inference-focused Ada) at $0.43-1.65/hr. The H100 rental price compression (down to $2.89-3.51 typical in Nov 2026 from $7+/hr in early 2024) reflects supply coming online, yet CoreWeave's bonds now yield 16-17% and CDS spreads above 1,200 bps, signaling credit markets doubt GPU collateral values can support the debt if depreciation accelerates. Amazon's reversal—shortening a subset of servers from 6 to 5 years citing AI hardware pace—directly contradicts Meta, Microsoft, Google, and Oracle extending lives to 5.5-6 years, creating a $176B earnings gap (per Burry) that hinges on whether Blackwell/Rubin render Hopper economically obsolete faster than the 5-6 year schedules assume.
